blocks.title: Advancing Inclusivity

heading: Strengthening MCMC.
Enabling Malaysia’s digital future.
text: MCMC P2630 is the Malaysian Communications and Multimedia Commission’s institutional transformation and execution framework for 2026–2030. It strengthens MCMC’s regulatory capability, organisational readiness and delivery discipline while supporting national and Ministry priorities.

As artificial intelligence, advanced connectivity and data-driven services reshape daily life, the plan sets a coordinated direction for a regulator that is more agile, responsive and ready for change.
It brings together one Vision, two Missions, six Strategic Thrusts and 30 Strategies to turn long-term ambition into organisation-wide action.

blocks.quote: “Through MCMC P2630, we will strengthen our ability to navigate technological change and ensure that it serves Malaysia’s development while expanding opportunities for our people.”
name: YBhg. Tan Sri Mohamad Salim bin Fateh Din
Chairman, MCMC
blocks.text: The foreword places the public interest, responsible innovation, trust and collaboration at the heart of MCMC’s transformation towards 2030.

blocks.heading: Malaysia as a Connected, Inclusive, Competitive and Future-Ready Nation.

items.title: Connected
items.text: Reliable and resilient communications infrastructure connects people, businesses and essential services wherever needed

items.title: Inclusive
items.text: Connectivity, digital services and opportunities reach underserved and vulnerable communities.

items.title: Competitive
items.text: Innovation, investment, productivity and industry capabilities support sustainable growth.

items.title: Future-ready
items.text: Institutions, infrastructure, industry and society can anticipate change, manage risks and adopt technology responsibly.

blocks.heading: A clear direction. Coordinated action.
blocks.text: The Missions guide MCMC’s direction. The Strategic Thrusts set its priorities, supported by strategies and delivery enablers.

items.text: A connected, inclusive, competitive and future-ready Malaysia.
Meaningful connectivity and a trusted, sustainable ecosystem.
Six priorities for sectoral transformation and institutional excellence.
26 thrust-level strategies and four cross-cutting enabling initiatives.

blocks.title: Two complementary missions.

heading: Meaningful connectivity.
A trusted digital ecosystem.
text: To realise the Vision, MCMC P2630 is guided by two complementary mission statements that strengthen Malaysia’s digital ecosystem.

The Missions guide MCMC’s contribution to a secure, trusted, sustainable and meaningfully connected ecosystem. Together, they balance the opportunities of digital growth with public interest, trust and sustainability.

blocks.label: Mission 1
blocks.heading: To Enable Universal and Meaningful Connectivity
blocks.text: This mission guides MCMC’s contribution to making connectivity accessible, affordable and useful across all communities. It brings together resilient networks, reliable infrastructure and the skills people need to participate in the digital world.

blocks.label: Mission 2
blocks.heading: To Cultivate a Secure, Trusted and Sustainable Ecosystem
blocks.text: This mission guides MCMC’s contribution to a digital ecosystem in which people and organisations can participate with confidence. It connects public trust and consumer protection with responsible governance, sustainable growth and long-term resilience.
